gloss: to swell; to become puffy; to be swollen

definitions.gloss: to swell; to become puffy; to be swollen
definitions.explanation: To become swollen or puffy, typically referring to body parts due to water retention, fatigue, or medical conditions.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}、{顔|かお}がむくむことがある。
examples.english: Sometimes my face is puffy in the morning.

examples.japanese: {塩分|えんぶん}を{摂|と}りすぎると{体|からだ}がむくみやすくなる。
examples.english: If you consume too much salt, your body becomes prone to swelling.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). No pair verb.

ASPECT:
むくんでいる indicates a current state of being swollen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{足|あし}がむくむ (legs swell)
・{顔|かお}がむくむ (face becomes puffy)
・{手|て}がむくむ (hands swell)
・{体|からだ}がむくむ (body swells)

RELATED NOUN:
むくみ - swelling, puffiness, edema
・むくみを{取|と}る (to reduce swelling)
・むくみ{防止|ぼうし} (swelling prevention)

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
むくみ is the common word for what is medically called {浮腫|ふしゅ} (edema). Common causes include standing for long periods, high salt intake, and poor circulation.
